pt_ate_sock.text: {{name}} swallowed a sock. A whole one. Now there is a vet visit and a very serious X-ray.

outcomes.surgery_fine: The sock is out. {{name}} looks embarrassed. The vet keeps it as a trophy.
outcomes.surgery_rough: Complications, extra nights, a bill with a comma in it. {{name}} pulls through.

pt_ate_chocolate.text: The chocolate cake you left on the counter is gone. {{name}} has frosting on the face and a guilty tail.

outcomes.emergency_ok: Charcoal, fluids, a long night. {{name}} is fine and learned nothing.
outcomes.emergency_bad: It was worse than it looked. {{name}} survives, but the bill and the guilt are huge.

pt_ate_toy.text: {{name}} ate the squeaky toy. You can still hear it squeak from the inside.

pt_ate_pills.text: Your pills were on the nightstand. Now {{name}} is acting strange and the bottle is empty.

outcomes.rush_saved: Quick thinking saves the day. You never leave pills out again.
outcomes.rush_lost: You were too late. The house is very quiet now.

pt_runs_away.text: The door was open for ten seconds. {{name}} was gone in nine.

outcomes.search_found: You find {{name}} two streets over, happily rolling in something unspeakable.
outcomes.search_gone: Nothing. You post flyers and leave the porch light on.
outcomes.posters_found: A kid returns {{name}} and takes the reward with the confidence of a banker.
outcomes.posters_gone: Three prank calls and no pet.

pt_runs_away_bad.text: {{name}} bolted into traffic chasing something. Brakes screech. You cannot look.

outcomes.run_fine: A scraped paw and a very scared driver. {{name}} will be fine.
outcomes.run_hurt: Surgery, a cast, and a long recovery.
outcomes.run_lost: {{name}} does not make it. You sit on the curb a long time.

pt_bites_neighbour.text: {{name}} bit the neighbour on the calf. The neighbour is now on your porch with a lawyer's number.

outcomes.apology_ok: The neighbour forgives you. The pie helped. So did the dog treat.
outcomes.apology_sue: He ate the pie and sued anyway.

pt_bites_kid.text: {{name}} snapped at a visiting kid who pulled its tail. Everyone is shouting.

pt_wins_contest.text: The neighbourhood pet show is on. {{name}} is groomed, perfumed and utterly unimpressed.

outcomes.enter_win: Best in show! There is a ribbon, a cheque, and a smug look on {{name}}'s face.
outcomes.enter_place: Second place. {{name}} acts like they won anyway.
outcomes.enter_disaster: {{name}} chews the judge's clipboard. Disqualified. Legendary.

pt_online_famous.text: A video of {{name}} doing something ridiculous gets shared everywhere. Strangers are making fan art.

pt_famous_brand.text: A company wants {{name}} to star in an ad. They say the pay is 'extremely competitive'.

outcomes.sign_great: Pay arrives. {{name}} now has an agent and a snack rider.
outcomes.sign_bad: The ad flops and {{name}} is a meme for the wrong reason.

pt_surgery.text: {{name}} limps and cries. The vet says a hip operation could fix it. Quote: a lot.

outcomes.operate_success: The operation works. {{name}} is chasing things again within weeks.
outcomes.operate_fail: Complications on the table. Nothing can be done.

pt_sick.text: {{name}} is off their food and sleeping all day. Something is wrong.

pt_fleas.text: You are scratching. {{name}} is scratching. The couch is scratching. Fleas.

outcomes.natural_works: Surprisingly, it works. You smell like a salad.
outcomes.natural_fail: It does not work. The couch is now hostile territory.

pt_stray_friend.text: A scruffy stray has been following {{name}} home. They share their food like old friends.

pt_sitting_disaster.text: You pet-sit for a friend. By noon the apartment looks like a crime scene.

pt_couch_destroyed.text: You come home to a snowstorm of couch stuffing. {{name}} sits in the middle, calm as a monk.

pt_snake_escape.text: {{name}} the snake is not in the tank. The lid is on the floor. Sleep tonight will be interesting.

outcomes.hunt_found: It is in a boot. The boot is now evidence.
outcomes.hunt_neighbour: It turns up in the neighbour's bathtub. You owe a casserole.

pt_parrot_swears.text: {{name}} the parrot has learned a new word. It is the word you said when you stubbed your toe. Guests are over.

choices.cover: Cover the cage with a cloth

pt_horse_race.text: {{name}} the horse has the legs for racing. A track owner offers an entry slot and a stern look.

outcomes.enter_win: {{name}} wins by a nose. You cry a little in public.
outcomes.enter_place: A respectable third. {{name}} seems satisfied with the oats.
outcomes.enter_lose: Last place, and a costly lesson about trainers.

pt_hamster_funeral.text: {{name}} the hamster has passed on, peacefully, mid wheel-run. The kitchen goes quiet.

pt_old_age.text: {{name}} is slowing down. Grey muzzle, long naps, stairs are a problem. Time is the thing now.

outcomes.bucket_magic: A perfect day at the beach. {{name}} smiles like a puppy.
outcomes.bucket_tired: It is a bit much for {{name}}, but the memories are good.

pt_old_dies.text: {{name}} does not wake up. It is quiet and gentle. You hold the collar for a long while.

pt_saves_fire.text: Smoke. {{name}} will not stop barking at your bedroom door. You wake up coughing and see the glow.

pt_saves_burglar.text: A noise at the window at 3 a.m. {{name}} gets between you and the dark doorway and growls.

pt_trick.text: You teach {{name}} a new trick. It takes forty treats and a lot of patience.

outcomes.teach_works: It works! {{name}} performs it for anyone who looks.

pt_vet_checkup.text: Annual vet day. {{name}} is hiding under the car.

pt_new_litter.text: {{name}} has become a parent. Surprise. There are five of them.

outcomes.keep_adopt: Friends take two. The other three charm your neighbours.

pt_bed_hog.text: {{name}} has decided your bed is theirs. You are on the edge. The edge is two inches wide.

pt_vacation.text: You have a trip planned. {{name}} watches your suitcase like it owes them money.

outcomes.bring_fun: An excellent trip. {{name}} insists on the window seat.
outcomes.bring_mess: Hotel cleaning fees and a lost sandal.

pt_walk_charm.text: On your walk, {{name}} charms a stranger. The stranger is surprisingly friendly and not hard to look at.

outcomes.chat_date: A phone number, a coffee date, and possibly a good story for later.
outcomes.chat_friend: A new friend, mostly thanks to {{name}}.
outcomes.chat_nothing: Just a nice chat and a sniff.

pt_trash_dive.text: The trash can is on its side. {{name}} is inside, eating a feast of leftovers.

pt_thunder.text: A violent thunderstorm. {{name}} is shaking behind the sofa and will not come out.

pt_cat_gift.text: {{name}} proudly brings you a gift. It is a bird. It is very dead.

pt_lost_collar.text: {{name}} comes home without a collar. You also notice a new scratch on one ear.

pt_dog_park.text: At the dog park, {{name}} meets a rival. They circle each other, tails up.

outcomes.let_friends: They become best friends in under a minute.
outcomes.let_fight: A scuffle and a small vet bill.

pt_diet.text: {{name}} has gotten round. The vet says 'weight management'. {{name}} says 'treats'.

pt_swim_pond.text: {{name}} jumps into the pond and comes back covered in mud, weeds and pride.

pt_birthday.text: It is {{name}}'s birthday, as far as you can tell. You know you are being ridiculous about it.

pt_neighbour_complaint.text: {{name}} has been howling while you are out. The neighbours slip a note under your door.

pt_moving.text: You are moving. The new place has a 'no pets' clause. {{name}} stares at you.

pt_pet_therapy.text: After a bad week, {{name}} sits on your chest and purrs, or breathes loudly. Either way, it helps.

pt_social_walk.text: A neighbour compliments {{name}} every day on your walks. They are clearly here for the pet.

pt_pet_scandal.text: {{name}} dug up the neighbour's prize roses. The neighbour posts a photo with a long caption.

outcomes.deny_pass: Nobody can prove it. {{name}} is smug.
outcomes.deny_caught: The security camera has a good angle.

pt_senior_rescue.text: A shelter calls. An old, tired animal needs a quiet home. {{name}} watches you across the kitchen.
